request_drafting_assessment.privacy_test: Integrated 360M worker generated with all network requests blocked after loading; no generation requests observed. Draft quality still needs separate acceptance.
request_drafting_assessment.selected_route: Local sourced template plus optional explicit GPT-6 Luna draft through the limited server-side service; manual Arizona AI Assistant / U of A GenAI prompts are alternatives.

hosted_model_test.status: Completed; three synthetic drafts reviewed, useful first drafts with human review
hosted_model_test.scope: Three synthetic cases; at most 700 output tokens each, no tools, reasoning none, store false requested
hosted_model_test.review_method: Codex review against the saved synthetic briefs and supplied dated inventory facts; not an independent resource-owner confirmation. Word/count/source-ID checks were also run. Raw API output retained separately.
hosted_model_test.cost_basis: Reported cache-write and cached tokens treated as subsets of input_tokens. Standard published rates; estimate only, no invoice reconciliation. No tool calls.
hosted_model_test.decision: Useful candidate for source-grounded first drafts with human review; no public integration approved by this test.
limits: Three synthetic examples, one generation each, all relevant facts supplied; no independent fact-finding.
No sensitive inputs, adversarial testing, repeated-run consistency, concurrency or real-user acceptance tested.
No matched-prompt comparison with browser models; no broad ranking or claim of error-free generation.
store:false requested; not a zero-retention guarantee.
No site endpoint, browser credential, automatic submission or recurring service configured.

integration_evaluation.scope: Small synthetic hosted acceptance, not a model ranking or reliability estimate
integration_evaluation.public_browser_check: Passed: one explicit consented public/synthetic DS draft, download and clear; 1440/768/390 widths
